## Introduction

Aspose.3D for Python is a comprehensive library for working with three-dimensional content.
It supports FBX format for loading and saving scenes, and provides a rich API for 3D
manipulation in Python applications.

## Key Features

The library allows you to read and write FBX format files without external dependencies.
The Python API provides full access to scene objects, materials, and animations.
Developers can integrate 3D processing into any Python application with minimal setup.

## Getting Started

Install the library using pip and import the module to begin working with 3D content.
The API surface covers all common 3D operations including mesh manipulation, format
conversion, and scene serialization.
